term: heavy singleton-probability core of threshold beliefs
definition: HeavyCore μ t is {x | 1-t<μ.real {x}} on a finite measurable sample space. The proved characterization identifies it with the intersection of all threshold-accepted events. Its acceptance exactly characterizes conjunction closure under the selected normalized finite probability profile. The core need not contain the actual state.
note: Strict inequality is load-bearing: singleton mass equal to1-t can be omitted by an accepted co-singleton.
